title: FrameflowBrandKit
description: The creator's look, used by every title, card and caption Frameflow renders. Every field is optional: what is left out keeps Frameflow's own look. File paths are relative to this file; use forward slashes.

font.description: A font file (.ttf, .otf, .woff or .woff2), or the name of a font installed on this computer.

text.description: Colour of the text; white when absent.

accent.description: Colour of the word being said in captions; yellow (#FFE14D) when absent.

background.description: Colour of title screens and of the plate behind cards; when absent, titles are on black and cards on dark grey.

logo.description: An image file, shown above the text of title screens.

uppercase_captions.description: Captions in capitals; true when absent.
